prompts.p01: What is the capital of France?
prompts.p02: What is Aurora Borealis? Answer in two concise sentences.
prompts.p03: Explain the difference between TCP and UDP, with one brief example use case for each.
prompts.p04: Describe six major components of a modern computer in separate sections, using exactly two sentences for each component.
prompts.p05: Explain solar, wind, hydroelectric, geothermal, biomass, and tidal energy in separate sections of approximately equal length.
prompts.p06: Compare Python, C++, Java, Rust, Go, and JavaScript in six separate sections, giving three sentences to each language.
prompts.p07: Explain processes, threads, scheduling, virtual memory, file systems, synchronization, networking, and security as eight independent operating-system topics, using exactly two sentences per topic.
prompts.p08: Explain cloud computing in separate sections: define virtualization briefly, explain containers in detail, summarize distributed storage in two sentences, discuss cloud networking in depth, give a short note on monitoring, and provide a detailed security section.
prompts.p09: Plan a week-long trip to Japan with separate sections: a short budget overview, detailed transportation guidance, a brief lodging note, an extensive food guide, a detailed Tokyo itinerary, a short Kyoto itinerary, and a moderate section on cultural etiquette.
prompts.p10: Explain internet infrastructure in separate sections: describe DNS briefly, TCP in detail, HTTP in moderate detail, TLS in detail, load balancing briefly, and content-delivery networks in moderate detail.
prompts.p11: Describe a machine-learning production pipeline with a short problem-definition section, a detailed data-engineering section, a moderate training section, an extensive evaluation section, a brief deployment section, and a detailed monitoring section.
prompts.p12: Analyze PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and Cassandra independently for consistency, scalability, and operational complexity. After those analyses, synthesize them into a recommendation for an online marketplace.
prompts.p13: Evaluate solar, wind, hydroelectric, geothermal, and nuclear power independently. Then use those evaluations to design and justify a balanced electricity plan for a growing coastal city.
prompts.p14: Analyze phishing, ransomware, credential theft, supply-chain attacks, denial-of-service attacks, and insider threats independently. Then produce a prioritized mitigation roadmap based on the preceding risk analyses.
prompts.p15: Write a comprehensive remote-work handbook with separate sections on workspace design, scheduling, communication, documentation, meetings, focus, cybersecurity, and wellbeing. Give each section approximately forty to fifty words.
prompts.p16: Create a comparative travel guide to Japan, Italy, Iceland, Thailand, Peru, Morocco, New Zealand, and Greece. Give each destination its own forty-to-fifty-word section covering cost, transportation, food, and one major attraction.
prompts.p17: Explain eight distributed-systems topics in independent forty-to-fifty-word sections: replication, partitioning, consensus, fault tolerance, caching, load balancing, observability, and consistency models.
prompts.p18: Write an introductory artificial-intelligence study guide with independent forty-to-fifty-word sections on supervised learning, unsupervised learning, reinforcement learning, neural networks, transformers, generative models, evaluation, and responsible AI.
